subtitle.message: Natural subtitle translations that preserve the video's context.

supportedPlatformsDescription.message: Supported platforms: Udemy, YouTube, TED, NVIDIA Academy, Vimeo, Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, O'Reilly, NVIDIA On-Demand, DeepLearning.AI

simpleSettingsTitle.message: Start free AI subtitle translation with Google Gemini

simpleSettingsDescription.message: If you do not enter an API key, subtitles will be translated with Google Translate.

simpleGoogleIntroGuide.message: Translate subtitles with Google AI. Create an API key using the guide below and enter it here; Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite is set automatically. Select Check API key to verify the connection.

simpleGooglePaidApiNotice.message: The free Google AI API often returns errors during busy hours. For steadier translation, we recommend a paid API in Advanced Settings: OpenAI gpt-6-luna or Anthropic claude-haiku-5-5 (about $$0.2–$$0.5 per 10,000 sentences; get the API key from each provider).

simpleGoogleApiKeyReady.message: Your API key is ready. Select Check API key to save it and verify the connection.

simpleGoogleKeyGuideTitle.message: Get an API key in Google AI Studio

simpleGoogleKeyGuideStep2.message: If this is your first time, create a project on the API Keys page. Use an English name such as 'Gemini Project'.

simpleGoogleKeyGuideStep3.message: Click Create API key, then copy the new key.

simpleGoogleKeyGuideStep4.message: Check your project's billing tier and usage limits. See the free and paid API usage guide below.

simpleGoogleKeyGuideStep5.message: Paste the key above. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite is set automatically. Select Check API key to verify the connection.

simpleGoogleFreeTierNotice.message: The Free tier has usage limits. Daily request quotas reset at midnight Pacific time.

simpleGoogleKeySecurityNotice.message: Treat your API key like a password. Do not share it or put it in public documents.

simpleTranslationFreeDescription.message: You can use Gemini's free tier for AI subtitle translation. Usage limits or high demand may delay translations or cause requests to fail temporarily.

simpleTranslationPaidDescription.message: If you translate frequently or need faster responses, consider a paid API plan from your chosen provider.

simpleTranslationLightweightModels.message: Lightweight models such as GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite let you enjoy much faster, more accurate translations at a low cost.

simpleTranslationUsageNotice.message: Costs depend on usage. Paid APIs may also experience temporary errors during periods of high demand.

simpleGoogleApiKeyRequired.message: Enter a Google AI API key.

llmParallelRequestsGuide.message: Process 1–8 LLM chunks concurrently in advanced settings (default: 3). Simple settings always use 1. Changes apply to the next translation job. Higher values may reach API rate limits sooner.

providerGuideGoogleTranslate.message: Default translation engine. Uses the Google Translate endpoint without an API key.

providerGuideDeepl.message: DeepL API provider. Find the API key on the DeepL account API keys page, then configure the endpoint for your Free or Pro plan. The Free plan has monthly character usage limits.

providerGuideOpenai.message: Uses the OpenAI Responses API. Create an API key on the OpenAI Platform API keys page, then enter a model available to your account. Usage limits and pricing can vary by account, model, and tier.

providerGuideAnthropic.message: Uses the Anthropic Messages API. Create an API key on the Claude Platform keys page. Requests include the anthropic-version header. Usage limits and pricing can vary by account, model, and tier.

providerGuideGoogle.message: Uses the Google AI Gemini generateContent API. You can create an API key in Google AI Studio, and the key is sent as a URL query parameter. Rate limits and pricing can vary by project, model, and tier.

providerGuideOpenrouter.message: Uses OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible chat/completions API. Create an API key on the OpenRouter keys page. The free plan and free-model API usage are rate limited.

providerGuideNvidiaNim.message: Uses NVIDIA NIM's OpenAI-compatible chat/completions API. Create an API key on the NVIDIA API keys page. NVIDIA API Catalog provides free endpoints for development and prototyping; usage limits may apply by model and account.

providerGuideLocal.message: Uses the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions format. localhost and 127.0.0.1 can use HTTP or HTTPS; custom servers must use HTTPS. For a custom HTTPS server, approve access to that domain when you fetch models or test the connection. Subtitle text and the API key, if entered, are sent directly to this server. In Base URL, enter only the part before /chat/completions. Example: http://localhost:1234/v1

preferYoutubeProvidedTranslationGuide.message: Instead of translating, shows YouTube's human-made subtitles in the target language, or YouTube's auto-translation when there are none. Human subtitles always come first. Turn this off to translate with your selected translation style.

phraseSegmentationSkipYoutubeManual.message: Use uploaded subtitles as they are

phraseSegmentationGuide.message: Regroups subtitles that are cut into short pieces, such as auto-generated captions, and site subtitles split in the middle of a sentence into readable phrases. Auto-generated captions with word timing keep each word at its original time.

translationOnTop.message: Show the translation above the original subtitle
